title: Grateful Dead Live at Student Center, Modesto Jr. College on 1969-03-28

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy 1969 Modesto show featuring a scorching Dark Star, fierce St. Stephen and a superb Death Don't Have No Mercy.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the Dead at peak ’69 form – Jerry’s SG is fat and soaring on Dark Star and Death Don’t, while the band rides a powerful groove through St. Stephen, Eleven and an incendiary Other One. The soundboard source is remarkably clear for its era, with warm tube‑amp character, a touch of tape hiss and occasional fuzz that adds vintage charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise across >15 reviews for both performance (energy, standout improvisations) and audio fidelity; few minor complaints keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, warm tube‑amp sound with vivid guitar tone; slight tape hiss/fuzziness typical of 1969 recordings; harmonica a bit loud in the mix but overall very clear and balanced.

poor_songs: St. Stephen (a few note it sounds a bit ragged)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly from hard‑rocking St. Stephen into the soaring Eleven, then dives deep with Dark Star and Death Don't, ending on a fiery Other One; transitions feel natural and maintain high momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rich, fat SG tone repeatedly praised; multiple hot solos on Dark Star, Death Don't, and overall soaring lead work.
band_member_comments.Drums: Great drumming noted especially during the Other One climax.
